idea-plugin.name: TreeInfotip
idea-plugin.description:
TreeInfotip plugin for IntelliJ IDEs.


GitHub | Issues |

    English:

  • Add comment information to the project directory tree

    • 中文：

  • 项目菜单树添加备注信息、颜色、图标



Send issues
idea-plugin.change-notes:
5.1.2

  • 修复部分图标设置后把目录树行高撑高的问题：可选图标里有 50 个长边超过 16（20×20、24×24、32×32、最大 48×48），现在会等比缩到一行的高度，小图标保持原样不放大
  • 颜色/图标对话框的下拉框预览同步缩放，选的时候看到的大小就是设上去的大小
  • Fixed oversized icons inflating the tree row height: 50 of the selectable icons have a long edge above 16 (20×20, 24×24, 32×32, up to 48×48) and are now scaled down to fit a single row, while smaller icons are left untouched
  • The icon dropdown preview is scaled the same way, so the size you pick is the size you get

    5.1.1

  • 引入 Kotlin/Java 混编，颜色转换、图标列表等内部工具类改用 Kotlin 重写，插件不额外打包 kotlin-stdlib
  • 颜色字符串解析遇到非法数字时返回空值而不再抛异常，配置文件手写错误不会再中断渲染
  • 图标列表初始化改为兜住 Error：新版 IDE 若删改 AllIcons 字段，最坏只是"没有图标可选"，不会导致插件加载失败
  • Added Kotlin/Java mixed compilation; internal utilities are now written in Kotlin without bundling kotlin-stdlib
  • Malformed color strings now degrade to no-op instead of throwing, so a hand-edited config can no longer break rendering
  • Icon list initialization now also catches Errors, so AllIcons changes in newer IDEs can no longer fail plugin loading

    5.1.0

  • 字节码目标从 Java 8 提升到 Java 17，与编译平台 2022.3 对齐
  • 最低支持版本随之从 2021.2（since-build 212）提高到 2022.3（since-build 223）；2022.2 及更早的 IDE 请继续使用 5.0.4
  • Raised the bytecode target from Java 8 to Java 17 to match the 2022.3 build platform
  • Minimum supported IDE is now 2022.3 (since-build 223) instead of 2021.2; stay on 5.0.4 for 2022.2 and earlier

    5.0.4

  • 新增「按扩展名批量设置」菜单：一条规则命中一批同扩展名的文件，范围可限定为当前目录（含子目录）或整个项目
  • 新增「覆盖显示名称」菜单：用自定义名称替换节点显示的文件名，留空恢复原名
  • 新增「设置悬浮提示」菜单：自定义鼠标悬停在节点上时显示的内容
  • 新增 XML 编辑工具窗口，可直接查看与编辑配置文件
  • 右键菜单全面中文化，新增「添加/取消删除线」
  • 保存配置时自动清理空属性，配置文件更干净
  • Added "batch by file extension" rule: one rule matches all files with the same extension, scoped to the current directory (including subdirectories) or the whole project
  • Added "override display name" and "custom tooltip" menu entries
  • Added an XML editor tool window for viewing and editing the configuration file
  • Localized the context menu into Chinese and added strikethrough support
  • Empty attributes are now dropped when saving the configuration

    5.0.2

  • 修复在新版本 IDE（2026.2 等）上右键菜单弹出时报 "Icon cannot be found in 'AllIcons.Actions.Menu_paste'" 导致菜单不可用的问题
  • Fixed "Icon cannot be found in 'AllIcons.Actions.Menu_paste'" which broke the project view context menu on recent IDEs (2026.2+)
